chapterTitle: Parts of Speech: Nouns, Pronouns, Adjectives & Adverbs
subject: english-9

questions.question: What is the denotative meaning of the word “snake”?
questions.explanation: Option (B) 'A creature with no legs' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: What is the connotative meaning of the word “home”?

options.C: A feeling of safety and comfort

questions.explanation: Option (C) 'A feeling of safety and comfort' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Which of the following shows denotation?
questions.explanation: Option (B) '“Rose” meaning a type of flower' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a word with a connotative meaning?

options.C: I planted tulips in the yard.

questions.explanation: Option (B) 'She’s such a snake.' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: What type of reference is used in this sentence: “Sarah lost her bag. She was very upset.”
questions.explanation: Option (C) 'Anaphoric' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Identify the cataphoric reference in this sentence: “Before he could explain, John left the room.”
questions.explanation: Option (B) 'He' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: What is an anaphoric reference?

options.A: When a word refers to something later
options.B: When a word refers to something earlier
options.C: When a word has emotional meaning
options.D: When a word has literal meaning

questions.explanation: Option (B) 'When a word refers to something earlier' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: What does a cataphoric reference do?
questions.explanation: Option (C) 'Refers forward to something coming' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: What is the denotative meaning of the word “child”?
questions.explanation: Option (B) 'Young human being' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Which of the following words has a positive connotation?
questions.explanation: Option (B) 'Assertive' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Which word has a negative connotation?
questions.explanation: Option (C) 'Cheap' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: What kind of reference is used in: “If you need it, the book is on the table.”
questions.explanation: In standard English conditional structures, 'Cataphoric' precisely aligns with the tense sequence and grammatical requirement of the if-clause and main clause.

questions.question: In the sentence “Tom loves pizza. He eats it every Friday,” what does “it” refer to?
questions.explanation: Option (D) 'Pizza' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: In “The teacher entered. She looked angry,” what type of reference is “She”?
questions.explanation: Option (C) 'Anaphoric' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Which of these is an example of a connotative meaning of the word “lion”?

options.C: A member of the cat family

questions.explanation: Option (B) 'A symbol of courage' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Identify the grammatically correct sentence:

options.A: He sailed across a Atlantic Ocean last summer.
options.B: He sailed across Atlantic Ocean last summer.
options.C: He sailed across the Atlantic Ocean last summer.
options.D: He sailed across an Atlantic Ocean last summer.

questions.explanation: Option (C) 'He sailed across the Atlantic Ocean last summer.' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly uses an article with a desert?

options.A: The travelers got lost in a Sahara Desert during their expedition.
options.B: The travelers got lost in Sahara Desert during their expedition.
options.C: The travelers got lost in an Sahara Desert during their expedition.
options.D: The travelers got lost in the Sahara Desert during their expedition.

questions.explanation: Option (D) 'The travelers got lost in the Sahara Desert during their expedition.' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Which article is necessary before "Holy Quran" in a sentence?
questions.explanation: Option (C) 'The' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence when referring to mountain ranges:

options.A: She climbed a Himalayas last year.
options.C: She climbed an Himalayas last year.
options.D: She climbed the Himalayas last year.

questions.explanation: Option (D) 'She climbed the Himalayas last year.' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Which option correctly completes the sentence? "Although she had visited many seas before, she was mesmerized by ___ Caribbean Sea."
questions.explanation: Option (C) 'the' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Identify the grammatically correct use of articles with abstract nouns:

options.A: A honesty is always the best policy.
options.B: An honesty is always the best policy.
options.C: The honesty is always the best policy.
options.D: Honesty is always the best policy.

questions.explanation: Option (D) 'Honesty is always the best policy.' is the correct grammatical classification based on its syntactic function in the sentence.

questions.question: Which of the following requires an article?
questions.explanation: Option (A) 'The Andes Mountains' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Select the correct sentence when referring to provinces:

options.A: The Punjab has a rich cultural history.
options.B: Punjab has a rich cultural history.
options.C: A Punjab has a rich cultural history.
options.D: An Punjab has a rich cultural history.

questions.explanation: Option (A) 'The Punjab has a rich cultural history.' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence with a canal:

options.A: The ship sailed through a Panama Canal.
options.B: The ship sailed through an Panama Canal.
options.C: The ship sailed through Panama Canal.
options.D: The ship sailed through the Panama Canal.

questions.explanation: Option (D) 'The ship sailed through the Panama Canal.' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Identify the correct superlative sentence:

options.A: That was a most exciting match I have ever watched.
options.B: That was the most exciting match I have ever watched.
options.C: That was an most exciting match I have ever watched.
options.D: That was most exciting match I have ever watched.

questions.explanation: Option (B) 'That was the most exciting match I have ever watched.' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Select the correct use of articles for a city name:

options.A: She moved to a Karachi last year.
options.B: She moved to an Karachi last year.
options.C: She moved to the Karachi last year.
options.D: She moved to Karachi last year.

questions.explanation: Option (D) 'She moved to Karachi last year.' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly follows the rule for lakes?

options.A: They spent their holiday at a Lake Superior.
options.B: They spent their holiday at Lake Superior.
options.C: They spent their holiday at an Lake Superior.
options.D: They spent their holiday at the Lake Superior.

questions.explanation: Option (B) 'They spent their holiday at Lake Superior.' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Which article should be used with the following phrase? "He is ___ most talented singer of his generation."
questions.explanation: Option (C) 'the' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: Choose the grammatically incorrect sentence:

options.A: The Amazon Rainforest is the largest rainforest in the world.
options.B: The Indus River is one of the longest rivers in Asia.
options.C: An Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
options.D: The Great Wall of China is a famous historical structure.

questions.explanation: Option (C) 'An Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.

questions.question: She pursued ___ MA in Linguistics from a prestigious university.
questions.explanation: Option (B) 'an' is the verified correct answer in accordance with FBISE Class 9 English SLO benchmarks.
